title: Eufy SoloCam S40 offline frequently
shortDescription: SoloCam shows offline despite full battery.
fullDescription: SoloCam S40 connects directly to Wi-Fi (no HomeBase). Solar panel mode causes nightly disconnects when battery < 10%.

code: VIDEO DOORBELL DUAL 2K NO PACKAGE DETECTION
title: Eufy Doorbell Dual package detection not working
fullDescription: Dual camera package detection requires HomeBase 2/3, AI training, and angle of down-cam aimed at porch floor.

title: Eufy HomeBase 3 BionicMind face training stuck
fullDescription: BionicMind requires SD card or HDD installed in HB3. Without storage, training silently halts.

title: Eufy Cam 3 built-in solar panel charging slow
shortDescription: Solar panel doesn't keep up with usage.
fullDescription: Built-in panel needs 2hr direct sun/day for trickle. Heavy live view or motion sensitivity high will outpace solar.

title: Eufy E2E encryption requires re-pairing all cameras
fullDescription: After Eufy 2023 cloud incident, true E2E encryption requires re-pairing each camera and is incompatible with web portal.

title: Eufy HomeBase 2 cameras say sleeping
fullDescription: Power-saving mode hibernates cameras between events. Battery management mode set to optimal extends sleep too long.

title: Eufy E340 doorbell drops 5GHz frequently
fullDescription: E340 5GHz radio struggles with thick exterior walls; falls back to 2.4GHz but app marks offline during transition.

fixSteps.title: Move router closer
fixSteps.instruction: Or add mesh node near front door.

title: Eufy Indoor Cam C220 pan motor stuck
fullDescription: C220 pan gear strips after debris ingress. Out of warranty needs gear replacement; in warranty RMA.

title: Eufy Cam 2 Pro false motion triggers
shortDescription: Cam triggers from wind / shadows / cars.
fullDescription: PIR sensitivity too high for outdoor scenes. Use activity zones and AI human-only filter.

title: Eufy geofencing doesn't switch home/away
shortDescription: Mode stays in away when home.
fullDescription: Geofencing on Eufy needs always-on location and battery optimization disabled. iOS background restrictions also break it.
